title: Medical record review (MSDS IMS-3)
summary: The quarterly review the Punjab Healthcare Commission requires - statistical sample, peer review against a checklist, deficiencies to the authors, corrective actions, the surveyor's report.
markdown:
# Medical record review (MSDS IMS-3)

The Punjab Healthcare Commission's Minimum Service Delivery Standards (MSDS) require hospitals to review their
medical records at least **every quarter**, on a **representative sample** chosen by statistical principles, by
**clinicians from the disciplines that write in the record** (not only the records staff), checking **timeliness,
legibility and completeness** of **open and closed** records, documenting the **deficiencies** and the **corrective and
preventive actions** (indicators 156-162). This module does all of it and prints the evidence a surveyor asks for.

Who does what:

* **Quality Officer** (role `quality_officer`, workspace `quality`; the Owner and Hospital Admin can do the same from
  the owner dashboard): plans, starts and closes cycles, records actions, reads the report.
* **Reviewers**: doctors and head nurses (`quality.review.perform`). Nobody reviews a record they wrote in: the
  database refuses (`RECORD_REVIEWER_IS_AUTHOR`).
* **Authors**: doctors fix the deficiencies found in their records; head nurses fix the nursing ones (vitals, doses).

## 1. See what is due

`GET /quality/record-review/status`: `next_due` names the last completed period (a quarter by default, setting
`record_review_frequency_months`) that no cycle covers yet, and `indicator_156` shows how a surveyor would rate the
review frequency over the last 12 months. The worker reminds the Quality Officer a week after a period ends, and again
when a cycle or an action is overdue (notification categories `record_review_due`, `record_review_overdue`,
`record_review_action`).

## 2. Plan a cycle

1. Pick the panel from `GET /quality/record-review/people` (`can_review`; `default_discipline` comes from the staff
   category). MSDS 158 wants several disciplines: at least a doctor and a nurse.
2. `POST /quality/record-reviews {"reviewers": [{"user_id": 12}, {"user_id": 15}]}` with no period plans the period
   that is due; give `period_start` / `period_end` for another one. Periods of live cycles cannot overlap
   (`RECORD_REVIEW_PERIOD_OVERLAP`). Change the panel with `PUT /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/reviewers`.
3. `GET /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/sample-plan` previews the sample: population and sample size per department
   and record state (`Active` = open inpatient records, `Discharged` = closed, `Visit` = OPD). The size is Cochran's
   formula for a proportion at the cycle's confidence (95 %) and margin (10 %), corrected for the population size and
   shared out in proportion, with at least `min_per_stratum` records from every stratum.

## 3. Start the review

`POST /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/start` draws the sample with a random seed (stored: the same seed gives the
same records), shares the records out among the panel (fewest first, never a record the reviewer wrote in), runs the
system checks and notifies each reviewer. From now on the period and the sample are frozen. A record that every panel
member wrote in has no reviewer: add someone to the panel and `POST /quality/record-review-items/{item_id}/assign`
it. Follow progress with `GET /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}` and the `record_review.updated` event.

## 4. Review a record (doctors, head nurses)

1. `GET /quality/record-review-items/mine` lists my records to review (by record number and MRN).
2. `GET /quality/record-review-items/{item_id}` returns the record (`snapshot`: notes with author and time, vitals and
   dose summaries, operations, documents, what was ordered), the checklist (`criteria`) and the system's answers
   (`auto_results`: Pass / Fail / NA with a detail line, re-run while the record is pending). Opening a record is
   logged as a patient-data access.
3. `POST /quality/record-review-items/{item_id}/review {"answers": {"ADM_REASON": {"answer": "Yes"}, "ICD_CODED":
   {"answer": "No", "comment": "No ICD code on the IPD note"}, ...}, "note": "..."}`. Every applicable item needs Yes,
   No or NA. A No, or an answer that differs from the system's check, needs a comment; otherwise
   `RECORD_REVIEW_ANSWERS_INCOMPLETE` lists the problems by code in `details.problems`. Submitting is final. Every No
   becomes a deficiency and notifies the record's author (nursing items: the head nurses).

The checklist (`GET /quality/record-review/criteria`) covers the three MSDS categories. Items with an `auto_check`
are pre-answered: reason for admission, diagnosis and plan of care (the admission's own, required since MSDS 149, then
the finalized notes), the signed operative note and post-operative plan of every operation, its anaesthesia records
(assessment, anaesthesia record, discharge from recovery) and its three checklist pauses
([surgical care](surgical-care.md)), the general consent of the stay and the consents of every operation and
transfusion ([consent](consent.md): given before the sign in, the signed forms scanned), the signed
discharge summary, the transfer record, vitals at the ordered interval, every due dose charted, the identity wristband,
the verbal orders countersigned in time and the patient's own medicines handed back
([medication safety](medication-safety.md)), every critical result told in time and acknowledged and the lab results
and imaging reports within their turnaround ([diagnostic services](diagnostic-services.md)), presenting complaint,
OPD diagnosis and plan, ICD code, no unsigned drafts, notes finalized on time (setting
`record_review_note_finalize_hours`), the certified death certificate of a patient who died (MSDS 153) and the whole
clinical autopsy trail (MSDS 154). The snapshot shows the death (`death`), the medico-legal case numbers
(`mlc_numbers`) and who recorded the admission's reason and diagnosis (`details_stamp`) of the record. The reviewer judges the rest (legibility, whether the discharge summary's six
elements say enough). The Quality Officer adds the hospital's own items with
`POST /quality/record-review/criteria` and rewords or retires them with
`PATCH /quality/record-review/criteria/{criterion_id}`.

## 5. Fix the deficiencies (authors)

`GET /quality/record-review-deficiencies` shows mine: the ones in my records (nursing ones for head nurses) and the
ones I raised. Fix the record the usual way (a correction entry: records are never edited), then
`POST /quality/record-review-deficiencies/{deficiency_id}/resolve {"status": "Corrected", "note": "correction entry added"}`.
The Quality Officer may instead mark one `Acknowledged` (true but cannot be undone, e.g. a late note: an action
addresses it) or `Withdrawn` (not a deficiency after all; the reviewer who raised it may withdraw it too).

## 6. Actions and closing

1. `POST /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/actions {"action_type": "Preventive", "description": "...",
   "owner_user_id": 12, "due_date": "2026-11-30", "criterion_code": "ICD_CODED"}`: a row of the hospital's action
   register. The owner sees it in "My actions" (`GET /quality/actions?mine=true`) and closes it with
   `POST /quality/actions/{action_id}/complete {"status": "Done", "note": "..."}`, even after the cycle has closed
   (see [incidents and the action register](incidents-and-sentinel-events.md)).
   The owner from `GET /quality/record-review/people`, the department from `GET /admin/departments`.
2. `POST /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/close {"summary": "the minutes"}`. The database refuses while a record is
   unreviewed (`RECORD_REVIEW_OPEN_ITEMS`), a deficiency is open (`RECORD_REVIEW_OPEN_DEFICIENCIES`), or deficiencies
   were found and no action is recorded (`RECORD_REVIEW_ACTION_REQUIRED`). A closed cycle cannot change.
   `POST /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/cancel` frees the period for a new cycle.

## 7. The surveyor's report

`GET /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/report`: the plan and seed, the panel with their disciplines, results per
stratum, per category and per checklist item (with how often the reviewers agreed with the system), the deficiencies
and the actions, and each MSDS indicator 156-162 rated `Met` / `PartlyMet` / `NotMet` with its evidence. Records
appear by record number and MRN, never by patient name.

Print it: `GET /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/report/pdf` (A4, the MSDS ratings first). The latest closed review is
also the `record_review_report` of the PHC inspection pack ([PHC inspection](phc-inspection.md)).

## Open questions (for the hospital, not guessed)

* The MSDS asks the hospital to define who may write in the record and the review policy in written SOPs; the system
  enforces them and prints the written IMS policy and the list of authorized personnel from the live data
  ([PHC inspection](phc-inspection.md)); the medical superintendent approves and signs them.
* OPD visits are sampled by default (`include_opd`); a hospital whose surveyors look only at inpatient files can leave
  them out per cycle.
